attractions.name: Gavi Safari
attractions.description: Safari passing through border of Periyar Tiger reserve with chances of sighting wild animals. Passes through hills, valleys, tropical forests, grasslands, waterfalls, cardamom plantations, and Pamba Reservoir. Home to over 320 bird species and endangered species like Nilgiritahr and lion tailed macaque

attractions.name: Abraham's Spice Garden
attractions.description: Walk through fragrant spice trails where cardamom, cinnamon, pepper and vanilla grow amidst lush greenery. Local guides explain Kerala's historic spice trading heritage.

safety_tips.tip: Avoid feeding animals inside wildlife areas. Maintain a safe distance from wildlife at Periyar Reserve and stay within designated walking areas, following guide instructions.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: When visiting temples or certain religious spaces, remove footwear before entering and dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered where possible.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: At places like Periyar Reserve and Eravikulam National Park, avoid loud noise and feeding animals to help preserve the natural experience.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx
